story_note: Isla returns to her morning ritual with a new Sapiver Press puzzle, noticing a fresh challenge.
continuation_note: She makes logical progress and wraps up the session with plans for tomorrow.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.caption: Isla settles in by the window, ready for today's challenge.
scenes.screen_state: Isla at laptop, plants on desk, window light streaming in.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.dialogue: This one feels different right away.
scenes.caption: Starting clues hint at a new twist in the day's puzzle.
scenes.screen_state: Close-up on Isla's focused expression and puzzle grid on laptop.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.caption: Isla hits a thoughtful pause, avoiding hasty moves.
scenes.screen_state: Isla tapping her chin, studying the puzzle carefully.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.caption: A key insight breaks the stalemate.
scenes.screen_state: Isla's finger pointing to a highlighted column on the puzzle screen.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: Now the rest falls into place.
scenes.caption: The grid begins to reveal its secrets.
scenes.screen_state: Puzzle screen showing more filled squares, Isla typing confidently.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.dialogue: Good progress today. Same time tomorrow?
scenes.caption: Isla logs off, already looking forward to a return visit tomorrow.
scenes.screen_state: Isla closing her laptop, a slight smile as sunlight fades.

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
